name: Cards
description: One row per card: cell 1 = image, cell 2 = title (as a link to the target page) and optional text. Use Story Rail or Stories instead when the cards should list pages automatically.

visualCharacteristics.purpose: card grid: image + linked title + text, one row per card

options.label: overlay
options.description: Title over the image (dark gradient), as the "Explore more" cards in the story sidebar.

options.label: overlay, tiles
options.description: Mosaic of tiles for series hubs and press-kit hubs. Each row starts with a size cell (sq, wide or third), then the image and the linked title. Keep the source order.

options.label: key-facts
options.description: Model page "Highlights": square image + h3 title + text per row. Keep the "Highlights" heading above the block as normal text.

options.label: social
options.description: Home page social profiles: one row per profile, one cell with a link whose text is the handle (e.g. @skodaglobal). Put it in a section with Style "cover-box, dark".

options.label: series-directory
options.description: The Series directory page: one row per series, image + linked title + excerpt below the image.

options.label: media
options.description: Media card: image with a media-style caption below.

options.label: toolbar
options.description: Card with an action row: each link in the last cell becomes a pill button (can be combined, e.g. Cards (overlay, toolbar)).
